description: KPI baseline for P2P wire protocol (Phase 1)

frame_encode_p99_us.description: P99 latency for frame encode (must be < 50 µs)

frame_decode_p99_us.description: P99 latency for frame decode (must be < 50 µs)

move_frame_avg_bytes.description: Average MOVE frame wire size (must be <= 48 bytes)

thresholds.description: Any metric worse than baseline by >5% is a KPI regression
